purpose: Bound ordinary fixed-ray pulse presentation work before persistent GPU lifecycle implementation; chain flights excluded even when originating from pulse weapons. GPU contacts enabled as common baseline.
consumer_findings: Ordinary pulse native body uses committed fixed_screen_step direction and authoritative projected position; no trail consumption.
Visual angle remains consumed by script fallback and weapon_impact; record/identity cannot simply be deleted.
battle_slice_runtime projectile_impact reads visual.fixed_step for position mapping.
Shared active/serial loops retain chain, missile, enemy and fallback consumers. prepare_flights separately rebuilds its serial index.
draw_pulse includes paint(rid) for preceding chain/missile/enemy geometry. That submission is an ordering barrier, not removable pulse work.
Persistent batches must preserve mixed flight order; current approximately 64 runs per frame means moving all pulses to one overlay changes alpha ordering.

Pulse frame/transform data can be replaced by born-state plus simulation time only with lifecycle publication, retirement and synchronization; existing loops cannot wholly exit while other flight kinds remain.
limits: These are instrumented scopes, not clean A/B performance gains. No production candidate or gain claim.
Per-pulse item scopes begin after classification/reference reads; those prefix costs were NOT allocated by kind. The identified sum is therefore NOT a full-chain upper bound.
Shared index cost includes all visual kinds and is not all attributable to pulses.
Flush cost includes required render commands/uploads; persistent GPU implementation would retain maintenance and upload costs.
Timers/classification add overhead; no overhead subtraction.
Initial PBP probe attributed preceding paint to pulses; PBP2 separates that barrier. Do not treat their frame-time difference as an optimization.
No current evidence establishes net >1 ms beyond fluctuation; do not construct a framework based on aggregate pulse entry time.
disposition: No persistent GPU pulse implementation started. Return concrete shared consumers and measured budget for scope decision, rather than claiming whole route disproven. Restore production scripts and common-baseline DLL.
